tools.name: search_cases
tools.description: Search the published case archive (Krimidex), newest first. Filter by text, case status and country. Returns summaries with provenance; use get_case for full text, timeline and sources.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: Get one published case as markdown with its timeline, sources, verdict and provenance.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search published news stories, newest first. Filter by text and date. Use get_story for the full text.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Get any published article (news, guide, review, profile) as markdown with sources and provenance.

tools.name: search_media
tools.description: Search documentaries, series, films, podcasts and books covered by the publication, newest first.

tools.name: get_related_media
tools.description: List the documentaries, series, films, podcasts and books the publication links to a case.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List topic tags (people, places, crime types, platforms), optionally filtered by text.
